items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: later it was Pete Harmon's place

ctx.x: Orzerman. Orzerman. Yeah, he played drums with them. Ernest Orzerman. Man, that tour was, it was terrific, man. And we used to, every now and then, we'd, at the Cadillac, you see, we used to get a lot of these, you know, people with money used to come down there. We made plenty of tips on that, it was a great job. And every now and then we'd get some rich guy come along, of course his chauffeur used to handle all the money, but man, he'd take us in his court, he'd take us over to like the little club and we'd…
Don't Leave Me Daddy was his hit. Don't Leave Me Daddy. But I still know, I still hear it.
